title: Aussie Dollar Falls to Lowest Since July as RBA Hike Bets Fade
summary: The Australian dollar touched the lowest level since early July, extending its decline after domestic labor data pushed traders to scale back expectations of interest rate increases from the Reserve Bank of Australia.

title: Fund Managers Quit to Trade Their Own Money in Taiwan Stock Boom
summary: The world’s biggest equity rally is creating an unusual bout of FOMO among Taiwan’s professional stock pickers.

title: MSCI Weighs Downgrade of Indonesia to Remove From Global Indexes
summary: Indonesia faces a potential ejection from global stock indexes after MSCI Inc. said the country no longer merits emerging-market status, escalating the threat of foreign investor flight as concerns deepen over market integrity.

title: Gold Rallies With Treasuries as AI Selloff Boosts Haven Assets
summary: Gold rallied, bolstered by lower US Treasury yields as investors sought safety in bonds following an equity selloff.

title: People in China are spending nearly as much of their income as Americans on healthcare
summary: Increasing government spending on healthcare could help boost consumption in China, the International Monetary Fund said.
